setup_required: First launch: create the administrator account using the link printed in the server logs.
error_unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running.
error_invalid_response: The server answered with an unexpected response.
error_client_too_old: This app is too old for the server (server requires API {min}–{max}). Please update the app.
error_server_too_old: The server is too old for this app (server supports API {min}–{max}). Please update the server.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
mfa_description: We sent a one-time code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing in.
error_otp_invalid: This code is invalid or has expired.
forgot_description: Enter your account email. If it exists, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
error_reset_token: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
reset_done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
files_empty_body: Drop files anywhere on this page or use Upload to add your first files.
brand_headline: A calm home for your files.
brand_body: Files, photos and documents on hardware you control. Private by design, fast everywhere.
feature_private: Your data never leaves your server
feature_realtime: In sync across all your devices
error_name_invalid: Names cannot contain “/” and cannot be only dots.
error_name_taken: An item with this name already exists here.
folder_empty_body: Drop files here or use Upload.
folder_not_found: This folder does not exist or was deleted.
trash_note: Items in the trash are deleted permanently after 30 days.
trash_empty_body: Deleted files and folders stay here for 30 days before they are removed for good.
delete_forever_body: “{name}” and everything inside it will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
error_restore_conflict: An item named “{name}” already exists in its original folder. Rename one of them first.
error_download: The download could not start. Try again.
move_partial: {failed} of {total} items could not be moved (a name is already taken in the destination, or a folder cannot go inside itself).
trash_partial: {failed} of {total} items could not be moved to the trash.
drag_hint: Drop on a folder to move
viewer_unavailable: No preview available for this file.
viewer_text_truncated: Only the beginning of the file is shown.
share_password_hint: At least 4 characters. Share it separately from the link.
share_once_note: Copy this link now: for your security it will not be shown again.
shared_note: Anyone with a link can view the item until it expires or you revoke it.
shared_empty_body: Use “Share…” on a file or folder to create a public link.
public_locked_body: Enter the password you received to open it.
public_not_found: This link does not exist or has been revoked.
storage_almost_full: Almost full. Empty the trash or delete files to free space.
totp_step_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp_invalid: This code is not valid. Check your device's time and try again.
security_2fa_off: Add a second step when you sign in: a code from an authenticator app such as Aegis, 2FAS or Google Authenticator.
security_2fa_on: On. Signing in requires a code from your authenticator app.
security_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
security_manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key manually:
security_confirm_code: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows
security_codes_body: Each code works once if you lose your device. Store them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
security_confirm_body: Enter your password and a code from your app (or a recovery code).
